Cooling Services in Columbia, SC

Cooling is the hardest-working system in a Columbia home. The season starts in spring, holds through October, and carries a humidity load the whole way, which means equipment here accumulates run hours faster than in most of the country. 2nd Wind Heating & Air Conditioning repairs, installs, and maintains cooling systems across the Midlands, and every recommendation comes with video of the diagnosed problem and a price you approve before work begins.

The technician starts with diagnostics, not assumptions: pressure readings, electrical checks, and airflow measurement to identify which component is actually failing. You see video of the finding, then the repair or replacement options with their prices. When replacement makes more sense than repair, we size the new system with a load calculation based on the home’s square footage, insulation, and duct layout, because an oversized unit in this climate cools the air without removing enough humidity, and an undersized one never catches up in August. Same-day emergency service is available for residential properties, and Cloud 10 members on our maintenance plans receive priority scheduling in peak weeks.

Schedule with 2nd Wind by phone, online, or 24/7 chat, and get a diagnosis you can watch on video before you spend a dollar on the fix.

Air Conditioning

Central air handles most Midlands homes, and most cooling failures trace to a short list of causes: a failed capacitor, a refrigerant leak, a dirty coil, or an electrical fault. Our air conditioning services cover repair, full replacement with a load calculation, and the seasonal maintenance that keeps run costs down.

Gas Packs

A gas pack combines the air conditioner and a gas furnace in one outdoor cabinet, which suits homes built on slabs without indoor equipment space. Our gas pack services cover both sides of the unit, since the cabinet that cools all summer also has to heat in January.

Ductless Mini Splits

Some spaces never get comfortable because the ductwork never reached them. Our mini split services put heating and cooling directly in a bonus room, garage, addition, or older home without duct runs, with each indoor unit controlled on its own.
